title: Junior Python Developer
description:
About the company
Acme is a fast-growing company based in Warsaw that builds innovative technology solutions for clients around the world. We focus on implementing modern systems and are happy to support young talent in our team. Our culture is built on mutual respect, open communication and continuous knowledge sharing.

Responsibilities
As a Junior Python Developer, you will be responsible for writing clean code and developing our internal backend applications. Your tasks will also include designing database queries and containerizing applications. You will work closely with experienced developers, which will let you grow your professional skills quickly.

Requirements
We are looking for someone with a basic knowledge of Python who can also work efficiently with SQL databases. We also require knowledge of Docker, which is key to our everyday software deployment process. We want a committed candidate who keeps developing their technical skills and learns quickly.

What we offer
We offer stable employment with a salary between 8,000 and 12,000 PLN. This position is fully remote, so you can do your work from anywhere. We also provide top-quality work equipment and expert support from the whole team from the first day of onboarding.

title: Backend Engineer
description:

title: AI Engineer
description:
